title: Dear SaaStr:  How Does a Sales Rep Truly Add Value?
content:
Dear SaaStr: Do salespeople add to the value received by customers? They do in the enterprise. At least the good ones do. That’s what a lot of founders miss if they haven’t worked with great mid-market and enterprise sales execs before. Let’s break sales down into 2 types: transactional and solution sales.
